name: Labeled Sample Compression / No-Clashing Teaching Dimension
details: The stable-compression NCTD lower bound does not hold for unrestricted labeled compression. On the six-cube, LSC is two but NCTD is three. On the full cube of dimension $6r$, LSC is at most $2r$ while NCTD is $3r$. This also excludes NCTD at most LSC plus any universal additive constant. Any universal bound NCTD at most $c$ times LSC plus a constant requires $c\ge3/2$; no existence or optimality of such an affine comparison is asserted.
proof_source: Full proof in the LaTeX survey: cor:compression-nctd-gap, using the database-owned six-cube decoder and cube NCTD value.
witness_verification: At dimension six, the certified endpoint values are two and three. Both quantities have linear order on cubes, so the growing additive gap is not an unbounded-ratio witness. Verified by sync/verify_six_cube_compression.py.
references: For the earlier strict separation: \cite{KSZ2019}, Proposition 28(2), and the five-cube construction of \cite{darnstadt2016order}, Example 2 and Lemma 12 in the cached August 2014 preprint. The stronger six-block and affine-slope consequences use the database-owned six-cube decoder in survey cor:compression-nctd-gap.
